artworks.title: Voila! t'es devenu rentier, moi médecin, lui...
artworks.description: Three individuals are depicted from the waist up, all wearing dark clothing and top hats. The person on the left is in profile, facing the center, with a long face and prominent cheekbones. Their hair is thin and tucked under the hat. The middle person is leaning towards the left individual, wearing glasses, with a round face and a few visible curls of hair beneath the hat. The person on the right is also in profile but slightly turned towards the center, with a long, narrow face and more pronounced facial features, holding a cane in front of them. They have their eyes slightly closed and their lips slightly pursed. The background is plain, emphasizing the subjects in the foreground.

artworks.title: René-Hilaire de Gas, Grandfather of the Artist
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of an elderly man and a smaller sketch of a woman. The man is depicted in a slight downward-facing profile, with deep lines and wrinkles on his face, wearing round glasses and a flat cap. The woman's profile is shown with short, textured hair. The background is plain with a speckled texture on the paper.

artworks.title: The Swiss Sentry at the Louvre (Le factionnaire Suisse au Louvre)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several men in front of a grand building. The men are dressed in top hats and long coats. One man with a walking stick is raising his coat to reveal something. Another man nearby is dressed in a military-style uniform and carrying a musket. The background shows a large domed structure.

artworks.title: Intérieur d'un port
artworks.description: The image shows a port scene with various buildings and boats. One prominent old building with timber framing is to the right. The horizon line is slightly above ground level, marked by buildings and ship masts. Several boats are docked along a stone quay, with one close to the viewer displaying wooden parts and sails. The illustration technique appears to be detailed etching, capturing patterns in buildings and boat textures. The color scheme is monochromatic with black, white, and grays, highlighting architectural details and people's activities. Farther away are masts and sails of more ships, suggesting a busy port area.

artworks.title: Radoub d'une barque à Marée Basse
artworks.description: The image is a black and white illustration of a coastal scene. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, showing the shoreline, cliffs, and rugged cliffs in the background. Near the cliffs, there are a few worn-out houses. Closest to the viewer, there are wooden boats on uneven ground, some with nets and objects. In the middle, figures are gathered around a boat being repaired. The sky is filled with swirling clouds, obscuring the horizon. The illustration features intricate brushstrokes that highlight the textures of rocks, wood, and clouds. The overall palette is monochromatic, using shades of grey to show depth, shadows, and light.

artworks.title: Retour au port
artworks.description: The image shows sailboats returning to port, viewed from water level. The horizon is slightly above the center, with cliffs or breakwaters extending across it. A sailboat with billowing sails is prominently positioned close to the viewer. The brushwork is fluid and dynamic, depicting the movement of the sails and sea. The color palette is monochromatic, in shades of gray and black, creating a dramatic atmosphere. Other boats can be seen in the distance, with less distinct sails and masts.

artworks.title: Title Page (Titre du cahier de six eaux-fortes)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with windmills on the horizon. A tall wooden post and foliage are on the left, while a stylized tree is on the right. The style features delicate brushstrokes, a monochrome color palette, and artistically incorporated text.

artworks.title: The Canal (Le Canal)
artworks.description: The image shows a river scene with a sailboat anchored near the bank. Buildings and trees can be seen in the distance. The style is akin to an etching with detailed linear strokes. The color scheme is monochromatic with shades of black on a cream background. Low buildings and trees are visible on the horizon against a sky with wispy clouds. Scrubby vegetation and wooden posts are in the foreground along the riverbank.

artworks.title: The Houses on the Canal Bank (Les Maisons au bord du canal)
artworks.description: This image shows a side view of a row of houses, capturing a street scene receding into the distance. The ground meets the sky where the horizon line is, with tree silhouettes along the horizon. The style is linear and illustrative, with deliberate ink lines outlining the buildings. The color palette is monochromatic with black ink on a lighter background, likely on paper. In the foreground, a fence and ramp lead to a house entrance, while more buildings and trees are visible in the distance.

artworks.title: The Nurse (La Nourrice)
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural scene with a house to the left, surrounded by bushes and trees. The brushstrokes are fine and sketch-like, creating a detailed effect. Shadows and depths are illustrated through cross-hatching. The color palette is monochrome in varying intensities of dark ink lines. A figure is visible to the right of the house, and tall trees fill the sky.

artworks.title: The Towpath (Le Chemin de Halage)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with two windmills, one in the distance and another close-up on the right. The setting is detailed with fine lines and a monochrome color palette. A figure on horseback stands near the windmill, while a boat with two figures is seen in the water to the left.

artworks.title: The Moored Boat (La Barque amarree)
artworks.description: The image displays a sailboat along the shoreline, with the horizon positioned towards the upper middle of the scene. Small structures, potentially boathouses, are visible on the left side, while trees and buildings are on the right. The sailboat is the central focus, with its mast extending upwards and to the right. The artwork uses precise thin linework and subtle etching, creating detailed rendering. The color palette is monochrome, emphasizing the linear and textural elements. The water shows gentle rippling strokes, indicating a calm surface, and the sky is open and empty.

artworks.title: Two Boats at Sail (Les deux Barques a voile)
artworks.description: The image portrays a coastal landscape scene from a slightly elevated viewpoint, showing the seashore, the horizon, two sailboats, two windmills, a path parallel to the shore with buildings, and trees. The artwork has a sketch-like style with fine lines, portraying a monochromatic color palette dominated by shades of grey and black. Clouds are depicted in the sky.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.description: The image shows a group of five people. One person is sitting with a small child on their lap, who is reaching towards a bowl held by another person. The seated person's head is covered with a cloth. The child wears a small crown. Behind them, three other figures are visible. Two have curly, shoulder-length hair and beards, while the third has short, curly hair. All wear cloaks with simple designs, except for the person holding the bowl, who is dressed in a garment with fur trim. The background consists of a simple curtain or drape.

artworks.title: Sleeping Shepherdess (Schlafende Hirtin)
artworks.description: The image depicts bold black lines forming intricate patterns of curved and angular forms. The shapes resemble intertwined human figures within an enclosure. The figures have a flowing quality with sweeping arcs suggesting movement akin to bodies curled in a fetal position or peaceful slumber. The background features angular lines and circular forms that evoke elements of nature. The composition intertwines abstract forms with a serene, natural environment.

artworks.title: The Book of Light
Landscape with a Coach
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a countryside setting, featuring a winding road, windmills, church spires, and tree lines. The horizon is low, and the brushstrokes are loose, creating an impressionistic feel. The color palette is subdued with shades of brown and gray. A cottage with a thatched roof and a carriage drawn by a horse are visible in the foreground, with more structures and windmills in the distance.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Cottage and a Large Tree
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic landscape with a thatched-roof cottage surrounded by foliage and trees. The intricate details of the vegetation are depicted with fine, crosshatched lines. A small path or stream is nearby, leading to distant structures and trees in the background. The scene is rendered in a monochromatic sepia tone, giving it an aged quality.

artworks.title: Allégorie sur l'Erection de la Statue de Louis XV (Allegory on the Establishment of a Statue of Louis XV)
artworks.medium: etching with traces of roulette and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a print showing a scene with large statues, swirling clouds, and several people. The lines are light gray against off-white paper, and many appear faded, making the shapes and forms hard to distinguish. At the center of the print is a tall statue of a person on horseback. People stand on the base of this statue, their arms outstretched upwards, one of them kneeling. To the right and left are more statues, seen from the side, that also feature people on horseback. Beneath them are crowds of people. Many of them hold objects, including scrolls, tools, flags, or bowls of fruit. In front of the central statue appears to be a pile of rubble, including several long logs and piles of fabric. A lion crouches on the left side, partially obscured. In the top left corner, figures appear amid the billowing clouds in the sky. Some of them look like cherubs, while others are indistinct. They appear to be holding a large, billowing fabric over the central statue.

artworks.title: Magician and Other Figures before a Burning Altar with Skull and Bones
artworks.medium: etching, reworked with pen and brown ink, and opaque white and gray wash
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group gathered around a large barrel. The scene features intricate line work depicting people standing and sitting in a circle around the ornate barrel. One person is sitting and appears engaged with an object. The drawing's style showcases detailed textures and nuanced expressions.

artworks.title: Seated Woman and Standing Man Surrounded by Other Figures and Paraphernalia
artworks.medium: etching, with pen and brown ink added to tree trunk behind foremost seated woman
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in a setting that includes a woman seated on a pile of belongings, a man holding a cylindrical object, and other figures around them. Objects such as swords and a shield are scattered on the ground. The background shows crumbling architecture and sparse trees.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a book cover. The cover is dark brown with gold embossing. The central design features a coat of arms surrounded by flourishes and scrollwork. The edges of the cover also have gold embellishments.

artworks.title: Joseph and Mary Prepare to Leave
artworks.description: The image shows several individuals gathered in a pastoral setting. In the center, a woman holds a child, both with halos. Beside her, a man with a beard holds a staff. To the right, a winged figure guides a donkey, which stands near the bearded man. On the left, another man looks on. The scene includes a thatched roof, a wooden structure in the background, and textured ground. The image appears to be an etching or drawing in black and white.

artworks.title: Joseph and Mary Prepare to Leave
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures in a rustic outdoor setting. In the center, a figure cradles a child. Another figure stands nearby with a staff next to a donkey. An angelic figure gestures towards the donkey. The background features aged wooden doors and stone structures, creating a humble atmosphere. The drawing style is detailed and captures the scene in a single moment.
